runtime_adversarial_rows.note: The remaining adversarial-matrix rows are execution/replay properties, exercised once EL-03/EL-04 exist; specified here so implementation cannot launder them into program semantics
runtime_adversarial_rows.transplanted_receipt: a receipt or output digest bound to a different invocation fails §7.O1 at digest comparison; the obligation stays open → not_evaluated
runtime_adversarial_rows.forged_certificate_recomputed_hashes: a certificate whose postcondition does not hold under the named primitive fails §7.O2; recomputing outer digests does not help (ADR-0026 context equality)
runtime_adversarial_rows.process_failure_or_absent_output: no observation → §7.O1 produces nothing → runtime obligation unmet → not_evaluated
runtime_adversarial_rows.budget_exhaustion: any §11 bound exceeded is an explicit bounded refusal, distinct from unsupported and from success
runtime_adversarial_rows.presentation_only_change: record text, notices, and ordering changes produce identical derivations; a semantic identity unchanged is a no-op
runtime_adversarial_rows.method_library_narrowed_expired_or_withd: a library revision is a new canonical identity; programs pin its sha256, so a superseding library never silently rewrites an existing derivation — reconsidering a use means a new evaluation under the new library identity, and the original derivation remains intact under its own context
runtime_adversarial_rows.requirement_limit_changed: the limit is a premise of the requirement rule; changing 1/4 to 7/20 or 9/20 re-derives the verdict while every method-application premise is preserved (the three clearance programs pin this)
runtime_adversarial_rows.input_geometry_method_or_material_change: dependency edges (§8.3) identify every affected application; derivation diff explains the change semantically rather than as a hash delta
runtime_adversarial_rows.imported_derivation_dropped_assumption: replay compares the import's declared assumption set against the source record's propagated assumptions (§9); a dropped assumption is a mismatch on the import premise
